routes.GET /: Responsive upload web page; static script and CSS served under /assets/
routes.GET /api/health: ok, schema, revision; requires initialized database
routes.POST /api/layouts: application/json {author, layout: dino-pve-layout/v1}; returns ok, id, duplicate
routes.GET /api/layouts/:id: schema=dino-scout-entry/v1, id, headquartersLevel, layout (compiled units and walls)
routes.GET /api/layouts/:id/raw: Published original editor JSON as an attachment; 404 when unpublished

publication: Validated uploads publish immediately; removed content cannot be uploaded again under the same compiled content hash.
deduplication: SHA-256 of canonical compiled entry; includes name, stage and array order; not geometric equivalence.
clientSync: Read manifest, fetch missing immutable entries, recheck revision, validate complete snapshot, atomically replace cache. Keep previous snapshot on failure. Freeze battle target until settlement. See scout-cloud-client.json.
